sportsdataverse.basketball.tpbl — 16 endpoints. Note: Unofficial and unsupported: these are the routes the tpbl.basketball site's own front end calls on api.tpbl.basketball (read from its JavaScript bundle). The API is keyless and needs no headers; tpbl.basketball/robots.txt answers 200 with an empty body (no rules, no crawl-delay). tpbl_runtime still spaces requests at least 1 s apart. SportsDataverse has not ruled on the site's terms, so payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Note: Coverage: three seasons so far (2024-25 = season 2025, to 2026-27 = season 2027, whose regular season starts 2026-10-17). There is NO play-by-play route (none of the site's 131 JavaScript chunks calls one); the two shot lists carry court coordinates only, with no shooter, game, quarter or time. Game wrappers serve FINISHED games only (an unfinished game raises AssetFetchError). Names (teams with their sponsor, venues, players, referees) are Traditional Chinese; the description of each code column translates it. Note: Ids: every route takes TPBL's own ids (season, division, team, game, player); the gohoops_* ids belong to GoHoops, the stats platform behind the league, and are echoed beside them. The box score keys its players by gohoops_roster_id (a person registered with one squad in one season), not by the TPBL player id: join tpbl_box_players to tpbl_roster on gohoops_roster_id. Season-keyed wrappers take the END year and the runtime maps it to the API's season id. Birth dates and contact fields are never returned. Note: Scope checks: the box-score wrappers fetch the game detail first (one extra request) and refuse a stats body whose teams, final scores, quarter count or player points disagree with it; the season game list, roster and player game log are checked against the object asked for. The two shot lists name no team, player or division in the body, so they cannot be scoped. tpbl_games(verify=True) additionally checks every division's completed games against its standings (falling back to the team-filtered lists for a division whose standings answer empty, as the 2024-25 playoffs do). tpbl_standings raises NoDataError for such a division.
